QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_34

question.text: During the Liquidation Period of a Cat III AIF scheme, before distribution, the manager is required to arrange bids for a minimum of ______ of the value of unliquidated investments, for the purpose of in-specie distribution:

explanation.text: The Logic: Upon receiving investor approval for in-specie distribution, the AIF shall arrange bids for a minimum of 25% of the value of the unliquidated investments. Dissenting investors exit out of this bid arrangement; any unsubscribed bid is allocated pro rata to non-dissenters. The Trap: 10%, 50% and 75% are surrounding distractors. 25% is the specified floor. Note: The 25% bid-floor requirement is set out in the workbook on pp. 357-358 as a precondition to in-specie distribution.
